# ETC

> ETC is a leading provider of professional lighting control systems, fixtures, and infrastructure solutions for theatre, film, architectural, and commercial applications.

ETC offers a comprehensive portfolio of lighting products including entertainment fixtures (Source Four LED), architectural systems (ArcSystem), automated lighting (High End Systems), control consoles (Eos, Hog), and power distribution infrastructure. The company serves theatre, film studios, architectural installations, and commercial lighting markets with integrated hardware and software solutions.

## Key Topics

- Lighting Control Systems
- LED Fixtures
- Entertainment Lighting
- Architectural Lighting
- DMX/Ethernet Networking
- Source Four
- ColorSource
- Eos Console
- Hog Console
- ArcSystem
- High End Systems
- Power Distribution
- Theatre Lighting
- Commercial Lighting
- Rigging Systems

## Products & Fixtures

- [Explore ETC Products](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products.aspx): Main products overview covering Source Four, ArcSystem and all ETC lighting categories.
- [Entertainment Fixtures | ETC](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Entertainment-Fixtures): Entertainment fixtures catalog featuring Source Four LED and professional stage lighting products.
- [Architectural Fixtures](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Architectural-Fixtures): Architectural fixtures including ArcSystem Navis, Pro and Desire LED luminaires.
- [Automated Lighting](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Automated-Fixtures): Automated lighting fixtures by High End Systems including Zeo, Halcyon and Lonestar.
- [Atmospherics](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Automated-Lighting/Atmospherics): Atmospheric effects equipment including FQ-100 and HQ-100 fog and haze machines.

## Control Systems & Consoles

- [Entertainment Controls](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Consoles): Lighting consoles including Eos, Hog and ColorSource for theatre and live events.
- [Architectural Systems](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Architectural-Systems): ArcSystem LED control systems featuring Paradigm, Echo and Echoflex dimming solutions.
- [Commercial Lighting Systems](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Commercial-Lighting): Commercial lighting systems with Echo wired and Echoflex wireless control options.
- [Networking & Integration Systems](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Networking): Networking systems including SiteLink, DMX gateways and cloud monitoring integration.
- [ETC Apps Overview](https://www.etcconnect.com/apps): Mobile applications for iOS and Android system control and configuration.

## Infrastructure & Power

- [Power Controls](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Power-Controls): Power control and dimming products for theatrical and commercial lighting applications.
- [Raceway, Track & Power Distribution](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Distribution): Power distribution including ColorSource Raceway and OneTrack lighting infrastructure.
- [Rigging Systems | ETC](https://www.etcconnect.com/Products/Rigging-Systems): Stage rigging systems featuring Prodigy hoists and theatrical rigging controls.

## Support & Training

- [Support & Training | ETC](https://www.etcconnect.com/Support): Technical support, training courses and LearningStage resources for ETC products.
- [Professional Services Resources](https://www.etcconnect.com/Support/Professional-Services-Resources.aspx): System design, installation and startup resources for ETC professional services.
